xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4398: Work agents that finished normally show "Ended unexpectedly": no "Handed to review" outcome

plan.title: Work agents that finished normally show "Ended unexpectedly": no "Handed to review" outcome
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: After PAN-4290, a work agent that ran `pan done` and whose PR is open (agent-pan-4358, PR #4375) renders "Ended unexpectedly" in attention color. deriveSessionOutcome in src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/sessionOutcome.ts has no row for a handed-off work agent, so row 11 (primary role, known open unmerged issue) fires. The paused guard does not help because the ended agent is absent from the store (/api/agents), so paused reads undefined. Planning nodes whose planningComplete is not true reach the same row because outcomeFactsFromSessionNode copies node.planningComplete without consulting the derived state.
narratives.Proposal: Add a quiet 'handed-to-review' outcome as a new row 11 (after rows 9/10, before the old row 11): role work/strike, not synthesized, issueState in {in-review, changes-requested, ready}. These states exist only when an open PR exists or a review/test pane is live, which is the in-browser evidence that `pan done` ran. No paused guard. Extract the drawer's post-planning state set into planFinalizedFromState() and use it in outcomeFactsFromSessionNode for planning nodes. Update docs/ISSUE-VIEW.md. Derive only; no server or contract change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No server change: no new SessionNode field, no contract change in packages/contracts, no endpoint, store slice, or polling loop.
- No exposure of the pipeline journal to the frontend and no PR head-SHA or timestamp comparison.
- No fix for ended agents missing from /api/agents (store drop); it is recorded as a hazard only.
- No change for parked issues: parked is not treated as evidence of a finalized plan.
- No change to worker, reviewer, review, or test outcomes.
- No change to useSessionOutcome.ts or to the surface components (AgentStepRow, SessionPanel, DrawerAgentSession).
- Rows 9 and 10 (recorded error, or recorded running with the pane gone) must not be outranked by the new row.

autoDecisions.summary: The handoff signal is the derived issue state (in-review, changes-requested, ready), not the pipeline journal or a PR-head-vs-last-commit comparison.
autoDecisions.rationale: The journal is server-only, DerivedPrState carries no head SHA or timestamp, the batch door drops branch facts when a PR exists, and the issue says 'derive only; store nothing new'. deriveState returns those three states only for an open PR or a live review/test/uat pane, so they are the faithful in-browser proxy.

autoDecisions.summary: The new row sits after rows 9/10 and before the old row 11.
autoDecisions.rationale: A work agent that crashed while reworking review feedback (recorded error, or record still running with the pane gone) must stay 'Ended unexpectedly' even with an open PR; only a clean end reaches the new row. The observed case (agent-pan-4358, recorded 'stopped') passes rows 9/10.

autoDecisions.summary: The new row does not check paused.
autoDecisions.rationale: A pause recorded after pan done does not undo the handoff, and the agent record can be absent from the store, making paused unreliable. A paused work agent with an open PR therefore shows 'Handed to review' instead of the plain fallback.

autoDecisions.summary: The planner fallback applies only to node.type 'planning'; legacy (synthesized) nodes keep node.planningComplete.
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the existing legacy-node test and PAN-4290 D5 semantics for synthesized rows; the 'planned' state means the canonical spec exists, which only pan plan finalize writes, so no git read for the 'chore(plan): complete planning' commit is needed.

autoDecisions.summary: parked is excluded from the plan-finalized state set.
autoDecisions.rationale: parked outranks planned and occurs with or without a spec, so it is not evidence that planning finalized.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 exactly. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/sessionOutcome.ts: (1) add `| 'handed-to-review'` to SessionOutcomeKind directly before `'ended-unexpectedly'`; (2) below `const PRIMARY_ROLES` add `const HANDED_OFF_STATES = new Set<IssueState>(['in-review', 'changes-requested', 'ready']);`; (3) insert a new row between the `// 10 — pane gone, no stop recorded` block and the `// 11 — primary agent ended cleanly` block: if role is 'work' or 'strike', !facts.synthesized, facts.issueState !== undefined and HANDED_OFF_STATES.has(facts.issueState), return { kind: 'handed-to-review', label: 'Handed to review', detail: 'The work agent handed off; its PR is open for review.', tone: 'quiet' }. Do NOT check paused. Comment it `// 11 — work/strike agent handed off ...` and renumber the following comments to `// 12 —` and `// 13 — fallback`. In sessionOutcome.test.ts add the tests named in PRD WI-1 (row 11 in-review work → Handed to review quiet; strike and changes-requested/ready loop; paused still hands off; recorded error/running on in-review → Ended unexpectedly attention; drawer adapter work stopped in-review → Handed to review; session node work stopped with no agent snapshot on in-review → Handed to review), add `facts({ role: 'work', issueState: 'in-review' })` to the 'no kind other than ended-unexpectedly ever returns tone attention' list, and rename existing 'row 11:'/'row 12:' test titles to 'row 12:'/'row 13:'. Do not touch useSessionOutcome.ts or any component.

expected_outputs: sessionOutcome.test.ts and useSessionOutcome.test.ts pass with zero failures

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-2 exactly. In src/dashboard/frontend/src/lib/sessionOutcome.ts add `const PLAN_FINALIZED_STATES = new Set<IssueState>(['planned', 'working', 'in-review', 'changes-requested', 'ready', 'merged']);` and `export function planFinalizedFromState(state: IssueState | undefined): boolean { return state !== undefined && PLAN_FINALIZED_STATES.has(state); }`. In outcomeFactsFromAgent replace the D6 expression (anchor `const planningComplete = derived?.state !== undefined`) with `const planningComplete = planFinalizedFromState(derived?.state) ? true : undefined;` keeping the D6 comment. In outcomeFactsFromSessionNode replace `planningComplete: node.planningComplete,` with a local: for node.type === 'planning', `node.planningComplete === true || planFinalizedFromState(derived?.state) ? true : node.planningComplete`; for every other node type, `node.planningComplete` unchanged (legacy nodes must keep today's behavior). Add the tests named in PRD WI-2 to sessionOutcome.test.ts. The existing 'D6:' and 'legacy node maps to role plan but is synthesized' tests must pass unchanged.

planFinalizedFromState returns true for planned, working, in-review, changes-requested, ready and merged, and returns false for backlog, parked, closed and undefined, asserted by a new test
A legacy SessionNode with derived state 'working' still returns SESSION_ENDED_FALLBACK, and the existing D6 drawer test preserves its results (true for six states, undefined for closed and backlog)
